pp2.2:1.3: so kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ, doso dussanā dussitattaṃ, vyāpatti vyāpajjanā vyāpajjitattaṃ, virodho paṭivirodho caṇḍikkaṃ, asuropo anattamanatā cittassa.
pp2.2:2.4: yo evarūpo upanāho upanayhanā upanayhitattaṃ aṭṭhapanā ṭhapanā saṇṭhapanā anusaṃsandanā anuppabandhanā daḷhīkammaṃ kodhassa,
pp2.2:3.3: yo makkho makkhāyanā makkhāyitattaṃ niṭṭhuriyaṃ niṭṭhuriyakammaṃ,
pp2.2:4.3: yo palāso palāsāyanā palāsāyitattaṃ palāsāhāro vivādaṭṭhānaṃ yugaggāho appaṭinissaggo,
pp2.2:5.3: yā paralābha sakkāra garukāra mānana vandana pūjanāsu issā issāyanā issāyitattaṃ usūyā usūyanā usūyitattaṃ,
pp2.2:6.5: yaṃ evarūpaṃ maccheraṃ maccharayānā maccharāyitattaṃ vevicchaṃ kadariyaṃ kaṭukañcukatā aggahitattaṃ cittassa,
pp2.2:7.4: yaṃ tattha saṭhaṃ saṭhatā sāṭheyyaṃ kakkharatā kakkariyaṃ parikkhattatā parikkhattiyaṃ,
pp2.2:8.3: idhekacco kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā tassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati
pp2.2:8.4: ‘mā maṃ jaññā’ti icchati, ‘mā maṃ jaññā’ti saṃkappeti, ‘mā maṃ jaññā’ti vācaṃ bhāsati, ‘mā maṃ jaññā’ti kāyena parakkamati,
pp2.2:8.5: yā eva rūpā māyā māyāvitā accasarā vañcanā nikati nikiraṇā pariharaṇaṃ gūhanā parigūhanā chādanā parichādanā anuttānīkammaṃ anāvikammaṃ vocchādanā pāpakiriyā,
pp2.2:9.3: yaṃ na hirīyati hirīyitabbena, na hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
pp2.2:10.3: yaṃ na ottappati ottappitabbena, na ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
pp2.2:11.3: sahadhammike vuccamāne dovacassāyaṃ dovacassiyaṃ dovacassatā vippaṭikūlagāhitā vipaccanikasātatā anādariyaṃ anādariyatā agāravatā appatissavatā.
pp2.2:12.3: yo te puggalā assaddhā dussīlā appassutā maccharino duppaññā, yā tesaṃ sevanā nisevanā saṃsevanā bhajanā sambhajanā bhatti sambhatti taṃsampavaṅkatā.
pp2.2:13.3: idhekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī,
pp2.2:13.4: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati na rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriyena saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
pp2.2:13.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya nimittaggāhī hoti anubyañjanaggāhī,
pp2.2:13.10: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ, abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya na paṭipajjati, na rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye na saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
pp2.2:13.11: yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ agutti agopanā anārakkho asaṃvaro.
pp2.2:13.13: imāya indriyesu aguttadvāratāya samannāgato puggalo indriyesu aguttadvāro.
pp2.2:14.3: idhekacco puggalo appaṭisaṅkhā ayoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti, davāya madāya maṇḍanāya vibhūsanāya yā tattha asantuṭṭhitā amattaññutā appaṭisaṅkhā bhojane.
pp2.2:14.5: imāya bhojane amattaññutāya samannāgato puggalo bhojane amattaññū.
pp2.2:15.3: yā asati ananussati appaṭissati assati asaraṇatā adhāraṇatā pilāpanatā pammussanatā.
pp2.2:16.3: yaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṅgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā apaccavekkhanā apaccakkhakammaṃ dummejjhaṃ bālyaṃ asampajaññaṃ moho pamoho sammoho avijjā avijjogho avijjāyogo avijjānusayo avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ avijjālaṅgi moho akusalamūlaṃ,
pp2.2:17.3: kāyiko vītikkamo vācasiko vītikkamo kāyikavācasiko vītikkamo,
pp2.2:18.3: natthī dinnaṃ natthī diṭṭhi natthī hutaṃ natthī sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthī ayaṃ loko, natthī paraloko, natthī mātā, natthī pitā, natthī sattā opapātikā, natthī loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammā paṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti
pp2.2:18.4: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyitaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ gāho patiṭṭhāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesagāho. ayaṃ vuccati diṭṭhivipatti,
pp2.2:21.3: yo kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ, doso dussanā dussitattaṃ, vyāpatti vyāpajjanā vyāpajjitattaṃ, virodho paṭivirodho caṇḍikkaṃ, asuropo anattamanatā cittassa,
pp2.2:22.3: pubbakālaṃ kodho aparakālaṃ upanāho, yo evarūpo upanāho upanayhanā upanayhitattaṃ aṭṭhapanā ṭhapanā saṇṭhapanā anusaṃsandanā anuppabandhanā daḷhīkammaṃ kodhassa,
pp2.2:23.3: yo makkho makkhiyanā makkhīyitattaṃ niṭṭhuriyaṃ niṭṭhuriyakammaṃ,
pp2.2:24.3: yo palāso palāsāyanā palāsāyitattaṃ palāsāhāro vivādaṭṭhānaṃ yugaggāho appaṭinissaggo,
pp2.2:25.3: yā paralābhasakkāra garukāra mānana vandana pūjanāsu issā issāyanā issāyitattaṃ, usūyā usūyanā usūyitattaṃ,
pp2.2:26.5: yaṃ evarūpaṃ maccheraṃ maccharāyanā maccharāyitattaṃ, vevicchaṃ kadariyaṃ kaṭukañcukatā aggahitattaṃ cittassa.
pp2.2:27.4: yaṃ tattha saṭhaṃ saṭhatā sāṭheyyaṃ kakkaratā kakkariyaṃ parikkhattatā parikkhattiyaṃ,
pp2.2:28.3: idhekacco kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā, tassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati,
pp2.2:28.4: ‘mā maṃ jaññā’ti icchati mā ‘maṃ jaññā’ti saṅkappeti, ‘mā maṃ jaññā’ti vācaṃ bhāsati, ‘mā maṃ jaññā’ti kāyena parakkamati,
pp2.2:28.5: yā eva rūpā māyā māyāvitā accasarā vañcanā nikati nikiraṇā pariharaṇā gūhanā parigūhanā chādanā parichādanā anuttānīkammaṃ anāvīkammaṃ vocchādanā pāpakiriyā,
pp2.2:29.3: yā hiri hirīyati hirīyitabbena, hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā,
pp2.2:30.3: yaṃ ottappati ottappitabbena, ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā,
pp2.2:31.3: sahadhammike vuccamāne sovacassāyaṃ sovacassiyaṃ sovacassatā avippaṭikūlagāhitā avipaccanikasātatā sagārāvatā sappatissavatā,
pp2.2:32.3: ye te puggalā saddhā sīlavanto bahussutā paññāvanto cāgavanto yā tesaṃ sevanā nisevanā saṃsevanā bhajanā sambhajanā bhatti sambhatti taṃsampavaṅkatā,
pp2.2:33.3: idhekacco cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī
pp2.2:33.4: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
pp2.2:33.9: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
pp2.2:33.10: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
pp2.2:33.11: yā imesaṃ channaṃ indriyānaṃ gutti gopanā ārakkho saṃvaro,
pp2.2:33.13: imāya indriyesu guttadvāratāya, samannāgato puggalo indriyesu guttadvāro.
pp2.2:34.3: idhekacco puggalo paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti
pp2.2:34.4: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya
pp2.2:34.5: yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya,
pp2.2:34.6: iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā’ti
pp2.2:34.7: yā tattha santuṭṭhitā mattaññutā paṭisaṅkhā bhojane,
pp2.2:34.9: imāya bhojane mattaññutāya samannāgato puggalo bhojane mattaññū.
pp2.2:35.3: yā sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā apammussanatā sati satindriyaṃ sati balaṃ sammāsati.
pp2.2:36.3: yā paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhanā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhanā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhavyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūrī medhā parināyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi,
pp2.2:37.3: kāyiko avītikkamo vācasiko avītikkamo kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo,
pp2.2:38.3: atthī dinnaṃ, atthī yiṭṭhaṃ, atthī hutaṃ, atthī sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthī ayaṃ loko, atthī paro loko, atthī mātā, atthī pitā, atthī sattā opapātikā, atthī loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
pp2.2:38.4: yā evarūpā paññā pajānanā …pe… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi
pp2.2:39.2: yo ca pubbakārī yo ca kataññū katavedī.
pp2.2:40.2: yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ nikkhipati, yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ vissajjeti,
pp2.2:41.2: yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ na nikkhipati, yo ca laddhaṃ laddhaṃ na vissajjeti,
pp2.2:42.2: yo ca na kukkuccāyitabbaṃ kukkuccāyati, yo ca kukkuccāyitabbaṃ na kukkuccāyati,
pp2.2:43.1: katamesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ āsavā na vaḍḍhanti:
pp2.2:43.2: yo ca na kukkuccāyitabbaṃ na kukkuccāyati, yo ca kukkuccāyitabbaṃ kukkuccāyati,
pp2.2:43.3: imesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ āsavā na vaḍḍhanti.
pp2.2:44.2: idhe’kacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo, so aññaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ sevati bhajati payirupāsati,
pp2.2:45.2: idhe’kacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo, so aññaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ sevati bhajati payirupāsati,
pp2.2:46.2: paccekabuddho ye ca tathāgatasāvakā arahanto tittā.
pp2.2:46.3: sammāsambuddho titto ca tappetā ca. ayaṃ vuccati puggalo titto.
